title: Base Write Single Coil variant 4
purpose: Exercise a conservative canonical FC05 request with a distinct unit identifier, coil address, and ON value using single-request shape.
expected_behavior: The server should validate the MBAP header and FC05 payload, write coil address 0x0013 to the ON state, and return the same request as response.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 equals the unit identifier plus the five-byte FC05 payload.
FC05 address and ON value fields are complete and ordered.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report is available; this is a conservative model-prior baseline and is not externally verified.
